text: dsh-loader-settlement-proof 是一个 DSH 插件，通过 DSH 工具、命令行和 MCP 接口检查 Loader 结算 receipt。它验证 DSH 修订版本与策略绑定、条目 declared 到 activated 的阶段顺序、必需条目是否启用并激活、请求与实际注入是否闭合，以及工具名称和 schema 摘要是否符合策略。检查结果整理为确定性的内容寻址报告，CLI 和 DSH 工具可写入指定目录并回读核验；MCP 提供内联 JSON 检查。适合需要核对已记录 Loader 启动结果并留存报告的 DSH 使用者。源码未要求额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-loader-settlement-proof checks Loader receipts via DSH tools, CLI, and MCP. It checks revision binding, lifecycle phases, activation, injection resolution, and tool schema hashes, then creates a content-addressed report. It requires no API key or external service.
想核对 DSH Loader 记录里的插件是否按阶段完成激活。
需要检查 Loader 请求的注入服务有没有全部解析到。
I need a report that checks whether recorded Loader tools match the required schema hashes.
dsh-loader-settlement-proof 的功能「结算记录核验」：检查版本绑定、生命周期、条目激活、注入闭包和工具 schema，并生成带发现项的内容寻址报告。通过 DSH 工具或 CLI 指定 receipt 与报告目录。
dsh-loader-settlement-proof 提供工具 dsh_loader_settlement_inspect：Inspect one revision-bound, body-free DSH Loader settlement receipt.
dsh-loader-settlement-proof 提供工具 dsh_loader_settlement_verify：Verify Loader phase order, activation, injections and tool schema receipts; write one content-addressed report.

dsh-loader-settlement-proof README · dsh-loader-settlement-proof：It emits deterministic, content-addressed JSON. The DSH tools/CLI can publish only beneath an explicit `artifactDir` and verify the bytes after publication. MCP is inline-only.

dsh-loader-settlement-proof README · Deliberate boundary：This is not another Loader. DSH `app-boot` already enforces live `assertEntriesLoaded` and `assertEntriesActivated`; `dsh-reloader` restarts a surface, `dsh-builtin-toggles` changes an allowlisted UI subset, `dsh-profile-lock-proof` proves installed composition, and the Awesome runtime matrix performs real cross-platform boots. This plugin verifies a producer-supplied, revision-bound settlement receipt for later audit. It never imports, runs, reloads, or toggles a recorded plugin and never accepts raw logs, stack traces, output, business bodies, or secrets.

dsh-loader-settlement-proof README · Usage：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dongsheng123132/dsh-loader-settlement-proof#<commit>
dsh-loader-settlement-proof inspect examples/settlement.json
dsh-loader-settlement-proof verify examples/settlement.json artifacts
```

DSH tools: `dsh_loader_settlement_inspect`, `dsh_loader_settlement_verify`.

MCP tools: `loader_settlement_inspect_inline`, `loader_settlement_verify_inline`.

`verified` means the receipt is internally consistent with its explicit policy. It is not a security certification and cannot prove that the receipt producer observed the live Loader honestly.

dsh-loader-settlement-proof README · dsh-loader-settlement-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

面向 DeepSeek Harness Loader 结算记录的离线证据层。它对固定、无正文的 receipt 验证：DSH revision/Loader contract 绑定，`declared → resolved → loaded → activated` 顺序，必需条目激活，inject 闭包，以及工具名和 schema SHA-256。

它不是第二个 Loader：不导入、不启动、不重载、不切换任何被记录插件。DSH 官方 `app-boot` 负责实时失败闭合；`dsh-reloader` 负责重启，`dsh-builtin-toggles` 负责有限 UI 切换，`dsh-profile-lock-proof` 负责安装闭包，Awesome runtime matrix 负责真实跨平台启动。本插件只把 producer 提供的脱敏结算记录变成可复核、内容寻址的判决。

dsh-loader-settlement-proof README · dsh-loader-settlement-proof：DSH/CLI 只读显式 workspace-relative 文件，只向显式 artifactDir 原子发布并回读。MCP 仅接收有界内联 JSON，不读文件、不联网、不执行命令。任何 secret、token、raw output、日志正文、prompt、stack 等形字段都会被递归拒绝。

```sh
npm test
npm run check
npm run smoke:plugin
npm run smoke:mcp

`verified` 只表示 receipt 与显式 policy 内部一致，不是插件安全认证，也不能证明 producer 如实观察了真实 Loader。
